name: readback-ruling-31-key-that-does-not-read-back
reference: spec 0.20 ruling 31: a switch key that does not read back on encode is transform-encode: the output would not decode; big is 256 via tbl; uint writes its low 8 bits, 0 (0.2); 0 has no table entry and the types differ, so reading it back fails (ruling 4 of 0.6)
